strings.description: Title of the one Home row that stands for everything over the plan's limit on a day (locked conversations and held recordings). {count} is how many.
Second line of the Home row for conversations over the plan's limit; the row has an Unlock button that opens the plans.

strings.en: Kept safe until your allowance resets
strings.description: Second line of the Home row for conversations over the plan's limit, on a build that sells no plan (no Unlock button).
Status line on a Home row whose transcription or summary has been running much longer than normal. Shown instead of 'Transcribing…' or 'Writing summary…'.

strings.en: Opens as soon as it's ready
strings.description: Short toast when the reader taps the 'Finishing up…' Home row before the conversation they just ended exists on the server.
